Let me check if there's a pre-built binary or how the target gets compiled.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace -type f -executable 2>/dev/null | grep -v ".svn" | head -30 && echo "---" && ls -la /workspace/</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
